title: Harry Potter
name: Harry Potter
description: A brave young wizard who discovers his place in the magical world and faces a destiny tied to the darkest wizard of his age.

title: Hermione Granger
name: Hermione Granger
description: Exceptionally clever, resourceful, and fiercely loyal; her knowledge and determination prove invaluable to her friends.

title: Ron Weasley
name: Ron Weasley
description: Warm-hearted and quick-witted, Ron brings steadfast friendship, humour, and courage to the most difficult moments.

title: Albus Dumbledore
name: Albus Dumbledore
description: A renowned wizard whose wisdom, compassion, and carefully guarded secrets shape the fight against darkness.

title: Minerva McGonagall
name: Minerva McGonagall
description: A formidable Transfiguration professor known for her discipline, sharp wit, and unwavering protection of her students.

title: Severus Snape
name: Severus Snape
description: An intimidating and complicated professor whose guarded motives make him one of the most difficult figures to understand.

title: Rubeus Hagrid
name: Rubeus Hagrid
description: A gentle giant with a deep love for magical creatures, Hagrid is among Harry's first and most loyal friends.

title: Lord Voldemort
name: Lord Voldemort
description: A powerful and feared dark wizard whose pursuit of immortality and control threatens the entire wizarding world.
